label: Propofol–remifentanil hypnotic synergy — Greco response surface (BIS, illustrative)

parameters.label: remifentanil effect-site potency (alone, weak hypnotic)
parameters.covariate_model: Ce50_remi = 0.04 ug/mL (= 40 ng/mL); remifentanil is a weak direct hypnotic

extraction.tier_rationale: Remifentanil alone barely affects BIS; the value chiefly sets the synergy partner scale.
Illustrative synergy magnitude; the qualitative effect (remifentanil markedly deepens propofol hypnosis / spares propofol) is robust, the exact value is not verified.

known_failure_modes.condition: BIS endpoint synergy is modest; analgesic/tolerance endpoints differ
known_failure_modes.behavior: A single Greco surface cannot represent endpoint-specific interaction (BIS vs tolerance of laryngoscopy differ markedly); parameters here are illustrative.

extraction.tier_rationale: The Greco response-surface MATHEMATICS is exact and round-trip validated; the PARAMETER VALUES are representative/illustrative (Tier C, unverified) pending field-by-field transcription of the Bouillon 2004 surface. Demonstrates the synergy capability honestly without claiming authoritative coefficients.

notes: E = E0 - Emax * U^gamma/(1+U^gamma), U = uA + uB + alpha*uA*uB, uA = Ce_prop/Ce50_prop, uB = Ce_remi/Ce50_remi. Drug A = propofol (hypnotic), drug B = remifentanil (opioid). All concentrations in ug/mL. At Ce_remi=0 the surface collapses to the propofol-alone sigmoid.
